finding: LocalTaskRetriever indexed route replaces requested metrics by an empty set when for_query reports qualitative. In this mixed task the global mechanism match also classified source-bound storage/performance requirements as qualitative. Thus _include_metric_tables is skipped for those queries.
boundary: This proves an indexed metric-table augmentation routing defect, not failure of every retrieval route or sole causation of all missing content. PDF supplementation and regular vector retrieval are separate paths.
nextAction: Separate global synthesis intent and source-bound query intent; preserve qualitative-only reading while enabling metric tables for actual measured-result requirements. Verify local retrieval against owned documents before another whole comparison.
